name: Sepulchrine-Apse
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past a tidally locked hemisphere, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Established during the last boom, the pirate hideout was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
There is money in carbon here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
